## Contracts, consumers, and exclusions
Preserve durable local push-pending state, non-failure classifications, backlog growth, best-effort/no-raise behavior, push policy and strict-S3 exception, detached-child secret stripping, retry budgets, scoped staging, and lock-through-commit atomicity. Preserve S3 lossless head folding, checked-out-ref cleanliness, publish-new-before-delete ordering; staging ownership/staleness and atomic promote/rollback; stamped-lock process identity and bounded duplicate-work race; the shared read/write store-usability predicate; and sync fetch-outside/write-inside locking, explicit refspec, union-not-reset safety, unrelated-history refusal, and fenced recoverable merge classes. Real consumers are library/CLI/MCP/reconciler store reads and writes plus their merge gates. The separately consumed push._resolve_conflicted_apply.__doc__ is in push_recovery.py and is not allowlisted here.

Concise or load-bearing prose outside the allowlist stays byte-identical. So do every runtime string, assertion, fixture, decorator, command argument, config key/value, and physical directive/shebang line. Repository-wide __doc__/inspect.getdoc census found no programmatic consumer of an allowlisted docstring.

## Verification and independent review
Compare each final file to d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84. For Python, parse with type_comments=True, replace only leading docstrings owned by the allowlisted Module/ClassDef/FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef owners, normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno, and require the remaining AST/runtime tree to match. A zero-context diff-hunk guard permits changes only inside the cited base spans; directive/shebang physical lines must match exactly. Run the structured focused, path, hygiene, diff, and untimed repository commands.

A reviewer who did not author the patch records a leaf-linked TSV with one PASS row per edited block (72 total): stable_id, before_citation, final_citation, preserved_contract_or_consumer, directives_exact, before_words, final_words, reviewer_session, semantic_pass, bloat_pass. Every final_words value must be smaller; missing, extra, or FAIL rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly the 72 allowlisted blocks are shortened; no other prose or directive changes.
- [ ] The immutable-base prose-only oracle passes for all 7 files.
- [ ] Every preserved contract above has a concrete independent-review PASS citation.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the declared paths; focused checks, diff-check, hygiene, and make verify exit 0.
- [ ] The independent TSV has exactly 72 complete PASS rows and proves a word-count reduction per block.
